summary: A tech-led selloff that originated in Asia and hit semiconductor stocks hard on Tuesday has repriced risk across equities, with memory chip names leading the drawdown as a crowded leadership group faces its first real stress test.
tweet: A semis rout from Seoul to Wall Street has tech in retreat, while the looming July 24 expiry of the Section 122 tariff surcharge forces a trade-policy reset that keeps the dollar bid and rate-cut hopes capped.
